17:24 Guidance to become a gospel teacher and preacher.

📖 "I'd Like to Know" | Bible Q&A with Seventh-day Adventist Pastors | SUMtv
Welcome to I’d Like to Know, a Bible Q&A program on SUMtv featuring Seventh-day Adventist pastors, including Pastor Stephen Bohr, President of SUMtv.
